section .data
    msg db "Hello, World!", 0x0A
    len equ $ - msg

section .text
    global _start

_start:
    mov rax, 1          ; write syscall
    mov rdi, 1          ; stdout
    mov rsi, msg
    mov rdx, len
    syscall

    mov rax, 60         ; exit syscall
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .text
    global _start

_start:
    mov rcx, 5          ; counter
    xor rbx, rbx

.loop:
    inc rbx
    loop .loop

    mov rax, 60
    mov rdi, rbx
    syscall
